papers.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
papers.problem: Tools that find cause and effect in time series run slowly because they need heavy statistical tests.
papers.fix: ITPD finds causes one variable at a time, running 2.3, 9.1 and 40.9 times faster than older tools.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you analyze large time series, a faster method lets you test cause links that were too slow before.
papers.limitation: The speed gain was shown in simulations on large graphs, not on real data.

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
papers.problem: Robots can still finish a banned task when they take over halfway, and they may drop the object they hold.
papers.fix: SAFI teaches robots to hold still on banned tasks, cutting banned task success to 1.3% with no physical incidents.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you build robot policies, test stopping mid-task, and train a hold response, not only a refusal.
papers.limitation: Tests covered one robot model on LIBERO tasks where holding is a fitting response.

papers.title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
papers.problem: Adding more driving demonstrations does not always help, because one planner may gain from data that harms another.
papers.fix: PAD scores each demonstration for the target planner, adding 3.5 points on NavTest and 5.0 points on NavHard.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you train driving models, score data per model and drop the weak samples instead of piling up more data.
papers.limitation: Results come from driving benchmarks, so real roads may behave differently.

papers.title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
papers.problem: Teams must pick which website changes deserve a live A/B test, and bad picks waste traffic.
papers.fix: Simulated shoppers from UX-1 predicted 267 of 318 past test outcomes correctly (84.0%), and a general model scored 61.6%.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you run A/B tests, simulated shoppers can screen ideas first, so you test the likely winners live.
papers.limitation: The study used past tests only, and it did not prove the method works on new tests.

papers.title: Islamic Social Financial Instruments and Sustainable Community Development: Evidence Synthesis on Community Resilience
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Research on zakat, waqf and sadaqah is scattered, so nobody knew how they help communities recover from shocks.
papers.fix: A review of 93 studies found zakat gives quick relief, waqf builds long-term assets, and sadaqah covers sudden needs.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you run a fund, combine all three tools, and back them with strong governance and digital systems.
papers.limitation: This is a review of past studies, so it shows patterns across papers and not new measured effects.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Sustainability sukuk have grown fast, but nobody had measured what drives how large each issue is.
papers.fix: In 11,944 issuances from 2012 to 2022, equity-based contracts, strong security, longer debt and USD or Euro raised issue size.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you issue sukuk, use equity-based contracts and major currencies, and expect high second party opinion costs to shrink issues.
papers.limitation: Growth is concentrated in Indonesia, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia, and the data ends in 2022.

papers.title: From Clicks to Credit: AI-Measured Halal Product Awareness and Halal Financing Depth across OIC Countries
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks lack proof that online interest in halal products leads customers to Islamic financing.
papers.fix: Across 16 OIC countries from 2014 to 2023, more halal searches raised total Islamic financing, mainly Murabaha and Ijarah.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you offer Islamic finance, search trends can signal demand, so push simple products like Murabaha and Ijarah first.
papers.limitation: Search volume is a stand-in for awareness, and Mudarabah and Musharakah showed only weak effects.

papers.title: Islamic Banking Products Accessibility and SME Performance: Evaluating Shari’ah-Compliant Financial Solutions for Somali Enterprises
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.leadAuthor: Ali Yassin Sheikh Ali et al.
papers.problem: Small businesses in Baidoa, Somalia struggle to benefit from Shari'ah-compliant banking, and the key barrier was unclear.
papers.fix: Affordability and ease of access drove business performance most, while general access helped less and awareness had little direct effect.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you design Islamic banking for small firms, cut costs and simplify service before spending on awareness campaigns.
papers.limitation: A one-time survey in one Somali city shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Examining the Impact of Waqf Literacy on Waqf Behaviour
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Waqf collection stays low, and it was unclear whether knowing about waqf makes Muslims give.
papers.fix: Among 642 Indonesian Muslims, waqf literacy raised attitude, social norms, control and past behaviour, which then raised waqf intention.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you run a waqf, teach people how waqf works, because knowledge leads to more giving.
papers.limitation: The survey covered Indonesia only and measured intention, not actual donations.
